title: Uniform clause distribution
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean-valued PCPP system making $r$ possible queries, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ have $K>0$ clauses for each seed. Its clause distribution is the uniform probability distribution on the $K$ clause indices.
